checks.detail: terminal step <= 83203, reset <= 256010, post-reset renderer <= 128005 cycles
entry/body plus 44-cycle autovector and 20-cycle rte <= 12996 cycles
no guest/register/input mutation command or GDB transport
no counter wrap/rebase; raw master spans retained and embedded measured VBlank bodies subtracted before ceil(/7)

limitations: Pinned BlastEm is emulator evidence, not physical-hardware timing.
The release gate covers neutral-input B01 on the Debug ROM; PAL double-step frames, other encounters, bosses, and Release-ROM equivalence require later campaign-wide measurement.

The native debugger's cycle value is a 32-bit master-clock counter. This attempt finishes below BlastEm's cycle-rebase threshold; any backward movement fails. Raw and VBlank-body-exclusive master-clock spans, ceil(/7) CPU cycles, and phase remainders are retained.

Each main session also measures every contained VBlank handler body. Those exact entry-to-rte-opcode master spans are subtracted from wall spans; the unmeasured fixed interrupt entry and rte costs remain in main results, making the exclusive-work budget conservative.
The natural GameplayCommitAndReset transition has an explicit 256010-cycle (two NTSC frame) ceiling; it is not folded into the 65-percent authoritative-step budget.
VBlank comparison uses the explicit NTSC 224-of-262 active-line contract and conservatively adds original-68000 44-cycle autovector entry plus 20-cycle rte costs to the measured handler body.

VBlank entry and shared-rte markers require DEBUG_BOOT_STAGE == BOOT_STAGE_RUNNING. The deliberate stage-3 acknowledge-only startup interrupt is excluded; every measured full-path span still starts at the actual vector entry and includes the status acknowledge and boot-stage check.

native_debugger_semantics.breakpoint_condition_semantics: condition INDEX EXPR is evaluated before command lists; false resumes immediately
native_debugger_semantics.breakpoint_overhead: breakpoint dispatch, console I/O, framebuffer refresh, and host wait consume host time only; the emulated cycle counter is sampled before the breakpointed instruction
native_debugger_semantics.command_list_semantics: commands INDEX executes in order; continue returns false from the debugger loop and resumes the emulated CPU
native_debugger_semantics.redirected_stdio_probe_result: anonymous pipes, inherited disk handles, and WSL PTY did not reach the -mwindows CRT streams; pinned terminal_win.c AllocConsole plus freopen requires console APIs
native_debugger_semantics.vblank_marker_condition_semantics: both VBlankInterrupt entry and shared-rte breakpoints require DEBUG_BOOT_STAGE == BOOT_STAGE_RUNNING; the deliberate pre-running acknowledge-only interrupt resumes without markers
native_debugger_semantics.vblank_running_scope: actual VBlankInterrupt entry before its first instruction through arrival at the one shared rte opcode, including the status acknowledge and boot-stage check
